MINERAL REFERENCE — REDSTONE

Irregular compact redstone mineral veins and inclusions with dark iron-red granules and subtle localized internal energy; no broad neon illumination.

Create only the mineral formations and their immediate contact details as an isolated design reference. The completed default_stone.png texture is supplied separately for final composition and must remain unchanged outside mineral-occupied areas. Do not generate, depict, recolor, illuminate or redesign the host stone. Avoid a full stone-tile rendering; concentrate exclusively on the ore deposits.
